title: Companion Allowance Set Aside from a Hotel Property Credit
content:
Where the rate plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range lets a companion sharing the room spend the credit, a companion allowance is set aside in the closing credit release according to the on-site charges taken by an occupant other than the lead guest.

Where the rate plan lets a companion sharing the room spend the credit and those charges number 3 or more, the companion allowance is 18.00 USD. Where the rate plan lets a companion sharing the room spend the credit and those charges number 1 or more but fewer than 3, the companion allowance is 9.00 USD. In every other case the companion allowance is nil.

| Plan lets a companion spend the credit | On-site charges taken by an occupant other than the lead guest | Companion allowance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Yes | 3 or more | 18.00 USD |
| Yes | 1 or 2 | 9.00 USD |
| Yes | None | Nil |
| No | Any number | Nil |

The number banded here is a count of on-site charges taken by an occupant other than the lead guest, not their money total.

*The combinations, on hypothetical folios.* On a plan that lets a companion spend the credit, a folio showing 3 such charges sets aside 18.00 USD; showing 2, it sets aside 9.00 USD; showing 1, it still sets aside 9.00 USD, 1 being the foot of that band; showing none, it sets aside nil. On a plan that does not let a companion spend the credit, a folio showing 6 such charges sets aside nil all the same.
